$comment: Prose only. The scale arrays that used to live here (typeScale, fontSizes, fontWeights, lineHeights, letterSpacings) were a hand-maintained THIRD copy of the type scale with no importers, and they had drifted: the display entry's weightToken said weight.medium while its own usage string said "Satoshi bold 700", and semantic.typography.display points at weight.bold. Six of the tokens they named no longer exist. Removed in hds#283 with the --hds-font-size-* block, for the same reason. The live scale is hirobius.tokens.json, rendered by src/stories/type-specimen.stories.tsx, which reads it at runtime and therefore cannot say something the tokens do not. Keep prose here; never re-add numbers.

definition.summary: Typography is a closed system: one body font, one mono font, and a fixed set of semantic composite tokens.

rules.rule: Use Satoshi for body and UI text. Satoshi Bold (700) is used for display, h1, h2, h3 headings.
Use semantic.typography.* composites for text styling instead of raw font values.
Skip Tailwind font utilities. Use hds.typeStyles.* inline style objects.
Use Geist Mono for token chips, inline code, file paths, and technical metadata.

usage.condition: Standard interface text: sidebars, nav, labels, inputs
